_comment: Demo fixture using Khronos's BoomBox glTF sample. Replace model.src with author-provided geometry for production.
title: Identify parts of a portable boombox
prompt: Click the tuning dial on the front of the boombox.

hotspots.label: Left speaker
hotspots.feedback: That is the left speaker. The tuning dial is the smaller circular control near the centre.

hotspots.label: Right speaker
hotspots.feedback: That is the right speaker. The tuning dial is the smaller circular control near the centre.

hotspots.label: Tuning dial
hotspots.feedback: Correct — the tuning dial selects which radio frequency the unit picks up.

hotspots.label: Carry handle
hotspots.feedback: That is the carry handle, used to lift the unit. The tuning dial is the small circle on the front face.
